name: guarantee-panel
title: Guarantee panel
description: Take the risk out of the decision: a clear promise (30-day refund, free replacement) with the terms in three plain lines.
docs: Pass title (the promise that follows the period: full refund, no questions), period (a value and a unit), terms (a term and a detail each, usually three: what is covered, how to ask, how fast the money comes back), policyHref and an optional action. The heading reads the period first, 30 days, full refund, no questions; write {period} inside the title to put it elsewhere, or word the whole heading yourself. The seal is drawn inline from concentric rings, a milled edge and a check, takes the page's colours in both themes and is hidden from assistive technology, so the promise reads without it. The terms are a real description list: three columns when the panel is wide and a stack when it is narrow. Place it beside pricing or just before the final call to action. labels translates the small line above the heading and the policy link.
